title: Abbas tumhe bali sakina ki qasam
body:
Abbas tumhe bali sakina ki qasam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tuh shere Jari hai, sakhiyo ka sakhi hai
Ya baabe hawaej meri fariyaad ko sunle.. 2
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aaya hu tere darpe badi aas hai maula, Har tute hue dil ka tu ehsaas hai maula , Tu ek samandar hai mujhe pyaas hai maula, Zakhmo ki dawa sirf tere paas hai maula.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri-2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Be dast sakhi apni sakhawat tu dikha de, Marte hue logo ki hayaat aur badha de, Tu chahe toh matti ko bhi akseer bana de, Bimaar ko ABBASE ALAMDAAR shifa de.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Milti hai tere darse gunahgaar ko izzat, Bat-ti hai zamane me tere hath se daulat, Aulad, shifa, rizq, hunar, lutfo sama'at, Isaar, wafa, ishqe khuda teri ata'at.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3, 4. Tu baabe hawaej hai sakhi ibne sakhi hai, Allah ke nazdeek teri baat badi hai, Jin maao ki godi abhi viraan padi hai, Awlaad unhe dede dua unki yahi hai.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haalat ne ay maula mujhe tod diya hai, Aalamo masaeb se mujhe jod diya hai, Tufaano ka rukh meri taraf mod diya hai, Apno ne bhi ab sath mera chod diya hai.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Har ek se ye baat toh karta nahi koi, Juz tere kahaan jaake wo phailaaenge jholi, Maa baap ke sino pe yahi bojh hai bhai, Beti ke naseebo ko jagaa do mere ghazi, Imdaad karo meri.... 2
<<MINI>>
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bejurm azadaar jo hai qaid me maula, Zinda'n me bichate hai magar farsh azaa ka, Mil jaae unhe sayyade sajjad ka sadka, De unko rihaae ki khabar warise zahra.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Ye kehke nigaaho ko tere darpe jhukaya, Bas sarpe salamat rahe maa baap ka saaya, De ilmo hunar baccho ko sehat bhi khudaya, Kab hamne kisi ghair ko mushkil me pukaara.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Aaya hu tere darpe ye umeed lagakar, Pehna hai tere naam ka taweez banakar, Dil kehta hai sarkaar se bas itni dua kar, MAZHAR ko bhi FARHAAN si aulaad ataa kar.
<<MINI>>
Imdaad karo meri.... 2
Ab waqte karam hai
ABBAS TUMHE BALI SAKINA KI QASAM HAI-3
